title: FERAL OVERTURE: Epic Cinematic BGM (original score)
description:
Something wild wakes up. It starts as a low growl in the dark, the ground starts to shake, and then it breaks loose: a huge cinematic overture that runs like a pack hunting at full speed and never looks back.

An untamed, epic score for big moments. Use it for hero entries, wild animal edits, trailers, sports hype and goosebump reels. Headphones on, volume up.

Music: Feral Overture, an original score by ÆTHER. Composed for ÆTHER, made with AI.
